Максимальная Скорость Энергии Торможения

The highest speed from which an aircraft can stop without exceeding the maximum brake energy limit, used to ensure brake system integrity and safety.

Quick answer: The highest speed from which an aircraft can stop without exceeding the maximum brake energy limit, used to ensure brake system integrity and safety.

What is Максимальная Скорость Энергии Торможения?

In this glossary, Максимальная Скорость Энергии Торможения refers to: The highest speed from which an aircraft can stop without exceeding the maximum brake energy limit, used to ensure brake system integrity and safety.

How is Максимальная Скорость Энергии Торможения used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Не превышайте максимальную скорость тормозной энергии, иначе тормоза могут перегреться и выйти из строя при прерванном взлете."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

The highest speed from which an aircraft can stop without exceeding the maximum brake energy limit, used to ensure brake system integrity and safety.

Operational example

Do not exceed the maximum brake-energy speed or brakes may overheat and fail during rejected take-off.
